name: AI Inbox Assistant – Gmail triage & drafted replies (Harborline demo)

parameters.content:
## AI inbox assistant (Gmail triage + drafted replies)
**Live demo:** https://n8n.rixgpt.com/webhook/inbox

1. A visitor sends a test email (or picks one of 6 samples); the workflow files it into the demo Gmail inbox as if it had just arrived.
2. **Gemini** reads it: category (lead / support / billing / meeting / newsletter / suspicious / other), priority, sentiment, one-line summary, next step.
3. Gmail actions: nested labels under **AI triage**, star + important for urgent mail, newsletters and phishing archived and marked read.
4. For leads, support, billing and meetings a **reply is drafted inside the thread** – never sent. A human reviews it.
5. Every email is logged to **Google Sheets** (Inbox triage tab); the owner view shows the last 7 days.
6. The same chain runs every 10 minutes for real emails that land in the inbox.

Successful executions are not saved (privacy). Daily cap 40 test emails.
Built by Aqib ur Rehman. Harborline and all senders are fictional.
### 1 · Demo page · a test email is filed into the Gmail inbox
### 2 · Result page: fetch → Gemini → labels / star / archive → draft reply in the thread → Google Sheets
### 3 · Every 10 minutes: the same triage for real emails that arrive in the inbox
